plainTranslation: Love turned into a power struggle. Possessiveness, jealousy, control, the urge to remake the other person. Failure mode: mistaking obsession for passion and tightening your grip. Drop the control - trust it or release it. Intensity is not compatibility, and a bond that runs on fear isn't a deep one.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry aspect material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
